title: Self-Discipline: Why Self Discipline Starts the Night Before
description: Self-discipline becomes easier when tomorrow's choices are prepared tonight. Learn how a simple evening routine can reduce decision fatigue, remove distractions, protect sleep, and make productive habits easier to start. From choosing one priority to preparing your environment and setting a shutdown point, these practical steps reduce morning friction without relying on constant willpower. Save this pin for later.
alt_text: Infographic showing how self-discipline starts the night before, with evening planning, a clear priority, prepared surroundings, fewer distractions, and protected sleep.
image_teaser_points: Choose tomorrow's priority and first action
Prepare your environment to reduce friction
Set a shutdown point and protect sleep
Use a simple five-minute evening reset
